title: Crispy Chickpeas with Green Beans, Peppers, Tahini Yogurt & Almonds

steps.text: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Place on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry; transfer to a medium bowl.
Add nutritional yeast, oil, and spices to the bowl with the chickpeas; stir to combine. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in a single layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place chickpeas in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until golden and crispy, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, place yogurt, tahini, vinegar, and salt in the reserved bowl. Stir to combine and set aside.
Once the skillet is hot, add almonds and cook, stirring frequently, until golden and toasted, 4-5 minutes. Transfer to a plate and set aside. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Wash, dry, and trim green beans; place in another medium bowl.
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers, then slice lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the green beans.
Return the skillet to high heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until blistered and tender, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide yogurt between plates; top with veggies, chickpeas, and almonds. Enjoy!
